lead_author: Principal Data Engineering and ML Validation Lead

classification_taxonomy.OFFICIAL: Data originating directly from authoritative government or transit agency systems (Delhi Transport Corporation, DIMTS, Delhi Open Transit Data portal) with verifiable cryptographic hashes or official distribution URLs.
classification_taxonomy.SYNTHETIC: Data generated through statistical simulation, heuristic modeling, or generative processes designed to replicate operational schemas when official data is restricted or pending release.
classification_taxonomy.DERIVED: Processed datasets, transformed features, aggregated indices, or serialized models generated deterministically from an identified upstream source (OFFICIAL or SYNTHETIC).

datasets.description: Statistically simulated ETM ticketing transaction records representing October 2026 DTC bus operations across 5 corridors, incorporating realistic missing alightings and Pink Pass concession tickets.

datasets.source: Delhi Transport Corporation & DIMTS institutional metadata
Delhi NCT arterial transit corridor definitions (Routes 534, 764, 427, 502, 620)
WGS84 geocoded bus stops mapped to Delhi OpenStreetMap and DTC terminal locations
Scheduled trip duty rosters for monitored corridors

datasets.transformation: Deduplication, passenger count bounds filtering [1-8], fare range cleansing [0-60], Pink Pass validation
Flow Conservation Solver L(s) = L(s-1) + B(s) - A(s) with power-law heuristic alighting allocation
